name: Paratroopers
help: Deploy Paratroopers on Revealed Territory.

name: Paradrop AT Gun
help: Deploy Paradropped 57mm Anti Tank Weapon and Crew.

name: Supply Drops
help: Paradrop Munitions, Fuel Supplies, and some Heavy Weapons to Revealed Territory.

name: Air Recon
help: Call in Recon Plane to scout targeted area of battlefield.

name: Strafing Run
help: Call in P47 Thunderbolt strafing run.

name: Bomber Run
help: Call in P47 Thunderbolt bombing run.

name: Raid
help: Light Vehicles can now capture Territory Sectors.

name: Calliope Rocket Launcher
help: Deploy an M4 Sherman outfitted with a Calliope T34 Rocket Launcher to the battlefield.

name: M26 Pershing Heavy Tank
help: Deploy an M26 Pershing Heavy Tank to the battlefield.

name: Fast Deployment
help: Vehicle and Tank production times are reduced.

name: Field Repairs
help: Vehicle Crews Repair battle damage while ability is active.

name: Allied War Machine
help: Tank losses are immediately replaced at the HQ while this ability is active.

name: Rapid Response
help: Infantry and Heavy Weapon Team deployment times are reduced.

name: Rangers
help: Rangers lead the way! Deploy Rangers, heavy Anti Tank Infantry, to the battlefield.

name: Off-Map Combat Group
help: Call Off-Map Infantry and Vehicle Reinforcements to the battlefield.

name: Defensive Operations
help: Enables Riflemen to Construct Field Defenses. Speeds up Engineer construction of Defenses.

name: Off-Map Artillery Support
help: Call in Artillery strike on designated target area.

name: 105mm Howitzer
help: Enables Engineers to deploy the 105mm Howitzer to the battlefield.

name: Level 1 Production
help: Decreases the upkeep cost of your troops and slightly increases the rate at which Riflemen Squads gain veterancy.

name: Level 2 Production
help: Greatly decrease the upkeep cost of your troops and slightly increase the rate at which Riflemen Squads gain veterancy.

name: M1A1C 76mm Gun
help: M4 Shermans are upgraded with the more powerful M1A1C 76mm gun. The weapon trades area effect high explosive for increased armor penetration. Researching this upgrade will also greatly increase the M26 Pershing’s chance to penetrate enemy armor.

name: Demolitions
help: Equip Engineers with Demolition Explosives to take down Buildings and Bridges

name: Mk2 Grenades
help: Equip Riflemen Squads with the Mk2 'Pineapple' grenade for flushing Enemy infantry out of cover, or attacking garrisoned Buildings.

name: Defensive Smoke Screen
help: Equip your M4 Sherman's with Smoke Canisters to create Defensive Smoke Screens.

name: Sticky bombs
help: Equip Riflemen with improvized Anti Tank weapons. Researching this upgrade will also increase the rate at which Riflemen Squads gain veterancy.

name: Aid Station
help: Medics are deployed to the Aid Station and will recover Casualties from the battlefield and return them to active duty.

name: M2HB .50 cal Machine Gun
help: Equip the M18 Hellcat with a M2HB .50 cal Machine Gun.

name: M2HB .50 cal Machine Gun
help: Equip the Armored Car with a M2HB .50 cal Machine Gun.

name: M2HB .50 cal Machine Gun
help: Equip the Sherman with a M2HB .50 cal Machine Gun.

name: M2HB .50 cal Machine Gun
help: Equip the Armored Car with a M2HB .50 cal Machine Gun.

name: M2 Flamethrower
help: Equip Engineers with the M2 Flamethrower.

name: Armor Skirts
help: Equip the Armored Car with Light Armor Skirts.

name: M18 57mm Recoilless Rifle
help: Equip Paratroopers with the M18 57mm AT Recoilless Rifle to provide an effective counter to Vehicles and hardened Structures.

name: Quad .50 cal Maxson Mount
help: Equip Halftrack with Quad .50 cal Maxson Mount. Cannot transport Troops when Equipped.

name: Thompson SMG
help: Equip your Rangers with the Thompson SMG.

name: Bulldozer
help: Equip your M4 'Crocodile' Sherman  with the Bulldozer.

name: Rocket Calliope
help: Adds a launcher capable of ripple firing large numbers of 4.5" Rockets

name: Crab Mine Flail
help: Equip the M4 Sherman with the Crab Mine Flail. Destroys Enemy Mines when deployed.

name: Minesweeper
help: Equip Engineers with the SCR-625 Mine detector to clear mines.

name: M1918 Browning Automatic Rifle (BAR)
help: Equip all Riflemen Squads with the BAR. Squads equipped with the BAR can use the Suppression Fire ability. Researching this upgrade will also increase the rate at which Riflemen Squads gain veterancy.

name: Captain ( Available from Field Support Truck )
Command Vehicle ( Available From Armor Command )
Secured Resourcing
help: Territory secured by this Command Truck will generate bonus munitions or fuel. Only one Secured Resourcing upgrade may be active among all command trucks at one time.

name: Become Mobile
help: Order the Truck to Mobilize. A Mobile Truck cannot create units.

name: Become Mobile
help: Order the Truck to Mobilize. A Mobile Truck cannot create units.

name: Set Up
help: Tell your mobile HQ to Set Up at its current location. A Set Up headquarters can create units.

name: Speed Governors
help: Engine governors are removed through field modifications, providing a large speed increase for your mobile Headquarters vehicle.

name: Convert to MMG Carrier
help: Adds Vickers Medium Machine gun to Bren Carrier to create a mobile machine gun. Cannot carry troops when upgraded.

name: Mine Plow
help: The mine plow enables Churchills to remove enemy minefields.

name: PIAT
help: Some PIAT (Projector, Infantry, Anti Tank) weapons are supplied to the Commandos.

name: Bren Light Machine Gun
help: The Bren Light Machine Gun adds much needed firepower to the Infantry Section and also enables them to slow enemy vehicles with accurate fire.

name: Disposal and Detection Section
help: The Sapper squad specializes in mine detection and destroying obstacles with demolitions pack.
extra: Addition: Plant Demolition Charge ability, Minesweeper

name: Expert Engineers
help: The Sapper squad specializes in battlefield repair of vehicles and structures.
extra: Addition: Repair ability replaced by Over Repair

name: PIAT
help: Sappers are issued PIAT Anti Tank weapons. "PIAT" stands for Projector Infantry Anti Tank.

name: Recon Element
help: Upgrades to a faster moving, but more lightly armed recon squad; also adds a well trained marksman and allows the squad to detect mines while stationary.
extra: Can utilize the Lee Enfield Sniper rifle

name: Rifle Grenades
help: The infantry section will upgrade their rifles to enable them to fire grenades.
extra: Good vs. Infantry and Infantry in Buildings

name: Tank Crew Commander
help: The tank crew commander will emerge to survey the battlefield, improving sight range.

name: Tank Crew Commander
help: The tank crew commander will emerge to survey the battlefield, improving sight range.

name: Littlejohn Adapter
help: Littlejohn Adapter increases projectile velocity and armor penetration of the 2 Pounder Gun.

name: 3" Close Support Gun
help: The 3" gun added to the Tetrarch provides more punch against infantry, emplacements, and buildings, but is much less effective against armored targets.

name: MG42 Heavy Machine Gun
help: An MG42 Heavy Machine Gun is emplaced inside the Bunker. The weapon fires on a fixed arc to the front of the Bunker.

name: Repair Station
help: Upgrade this Bunker to a Repair Facility. Specially trained Pioneers will automatically Repair damaged Vehicles in the vicinity of the Bunker.

name: Flammenwerfer 42
help: Equip Pioneers with the Flammenwerfer 42 portable Flamethrower.

name: Flammenwerfers
help: Equip this Halftrack with two Flammenwerfers. Transport space is cut to manage the huge Fuel reservoir.

name: Walking Stuka
help: Equip this Halftrack with Wurfrahmen 40 Rockets. Known as the 'Walking Stuka' because of its distinctive sounds the Rockets made while firing.
extra: Area of Effect. Good vs. Infantry and Light Vehicles.

name: Puma 50mm Gun
help: Equip the SdKfz 234 Armored Car with a 50mm Anti Tank Gun turret.

name: MG42 Light Machine Gun
help: Equip Squad with MG42 Light Machine Gun. The addition of an MG42 Light Machine Gun to the Squad vastly improves their firepower, but at a slight reduction of mobility.

name: Frankfurt 42 Mine Detector
help: Equip your Pioneers with the Frankfurt 42 Mine detector.

name: MP44 Sturmgewehr (Assault Rifles)
help: Equip Squad with MP44 Assault Rifles. MP44s provide Squads with excellent mid and short-range firepower.

name: RPzB 54 Panzerschreck
help: Equip Squad with Panzerschreck. One of the deadliest Anti Tank weapons of the war, the RPzB 54 Panzerschreck could penetrate the armor of any Allied tank.

name: MP40 Sub-Machine Gun
help: Volksgrenadier Squads get improved short-range firepower with the MP40 Sub-Machine Gun.

name: Escalate to Skirmish Phase
help: Requisition the Krieg Barracks to deploy Grenadier Squads, Mortar teams, Halftracks, and the Pak 38 Anti Tank Gun.

name: Escalate to Assault Phase
help: Requisition the Sturm Armory to deploy Officers, Stug Ivs., Geschutzwagens, SdKfz 234 Armored Cars, and the Nebelwerfer Rocket Battery.

name: Escalate to Battle Phase
help: Requisition Panzer Command to deploy the Knights Cross Holder, Ostwind Flak Panzer, Panzer IV, and the Panther Heavy Tank.

name: Veteran Infantry Squads
help: Requisition Veteran Infantry Squads. Call in Eastern Front Veteran Volksgrenadiers, Grenadiers, Stormtrooper, Knights Cross Holders, and Officers.

name: Crack Infantry
help: Infantry are trained to Crack level.

name: Elite Infantry
help: Infantry reach Elite status.

name: Veteran Support Units
help: Requisition Veteran Support Units. Includes  HMG and Mortar sections, Snipers, Pioneers, and Nebelwerfers.

name: Crack Support Units
help: Upgrade your support Squads to level 2 Veterancy.

name: Elite Support Units
help: Support Units reach Elite status with lots of combat experience.

name: Veteran Tanks
help: Requisition Veteran Tank Crews. Tanks include the Stug, StuH, Ostwind Flakpanzer, Panzer IV, Panthers, and Tigers.

name: Crack Tank Crew
help: Crack tank Crews have lots of combat experience and operate at a high level of proficiency.

name: Elite Tanks
help: Elite Tank Crews have abundant combat experience.

name: Veteran Vehicles
help: Requisition Veteran Vehicles. Vehicles include Motorcycles, Schwimmwagens, Halftracks, Pumas, 50mm Pak38 AT Guns, and 88mm Flak 36s.

name: Crack Vehicles
help: Combat experience leads to Crack status.

name: Elite Vehicles
help: Elite vehicle Crews have years of combat experience.

name: Infantry Assault Team
help: Call Off-Map Stormtrooper Reinforcements to the battlefield. Ideal for general battlefield actions.

name: Urban Assault Support
help: Call an Off-Map Stuh 42 assault howitzer to the battlefield. Ideal for urban assault operations.

name: Armored Assault Force
help: Call an Off-Map Tiger Tank Reinforcement to the battlefield. Ideal for major assault operations.

name: Assault Grenadiers
help: Enables Infantry Squads to Assault targets with Grenades.

name: Blitzkrieg Assault!
help: Enables all Vehicles and Infantry to attack with overwhelming speed while this ability is active.

name: Resource Blitz
help: Receive a large Manpower bonus in exchange for freezing your Economy for a short period of time.

name: For the Fatherland!
help: Zealous patriotism gives all friendly Units in controlled Territory a defensive bonus.

name: Fortify the Perimeter
help: Upgrades all Base Buildings with Defensive Machine Guns. Enables Reinforcement around Bunkers.

name: 88mm Flak 36 AT/AA
help: Enables Pioneers to deploy the 88mm Flak 36 AA/AT to the battlefield.

name: Advanced Warning
help: Increases the visual range of all captured Points, revealing more of the surrounding Territory.

name: Registered Artillery
help: Call Off-Map Defensive Artillery Bombardment on one of your threatened Structures or Secured Points.

name: Rocket Artillery
help: Call Off-Map Barrage of devestating 280mm Rockets to target area.

name: Activate Panther Battlegroup
help: Enables two Panther tanks to be allocated to support offensive operations.

name: Artillerie Kommand
help: Panzer Grenadier Bonus: Unlocks the Panzerschreck upgrade
extra: Can Construct: Light AT halftrack, Bergetiger Recovery Vehicle, Panzer IV Infantry Support Tank

name: Support Kommand Upgrade
help: Enables the construction of heavy support vehicles.
extra: Makes available: Panzer IV Infantry Support Tank and Hotchkiss Light Tank

name: Jager Kommand
help: Panzer Grenadier Bonus: Unlocks the MP44 Upgrade
extra: Can Construct: Assault Grenadiers, Funkwagen 250/5 'Vampire', Marder III Tank Hunter

name: Jager Kommand Upgrade
help: The Jager Kommand can produce the Marder III Tank Hunter.
extra: Makes available: Marder III Tank Hunter

name: Logistik Upgrade
help: Upgrade this Scout Car with the ability to lock down and secure the targeted territory sector.

name: FG42 Assault Rifle
help: Equip Fallschirmjager with FG42 Assault Rifles for increased firepower.

name: Spotting Scope
help: The Spotting Scope increases sight and gun range of the Hetzer Tank Destroyer.

name: Long-barreled 37mm Cannon
help: Upgrade the Hotchkiss Main Turret to a long-barreled 37mm SA 18 gun utilizing armor piercing rounds.

name: Walking Stuka
help: Equip this Hotchkiss with Wurfrahmen 40 Rockets. Known as the 'Walking Stuka' because of its distinctive sounds the Rockets made while firing.
extra: Area of Effect. Good vs. Infantry and Light Vehicles.

name: Armor Skirts
help: Equips the Panzer IV with Armored 'Skurzen' that can lessen the impact of high explosive and shaped-charge rounds.

name: MG42 gunner
help: Upgrades the Panzer IV with an MG42 gunner.

name: Panzerschreck
help: Equip your Panzer Elite squad with an armor destroying Panzerschreck.

name: Panzerschreck
help: Equip your Panzer Elite squad with an armor destroying Panzerschreck.

name: Gewehr 43 Package
help: Equip your Panzer Elite squad with two Gewehr 43 Rifles, excellent at long-range combat.

name: MP44 Sturmgewehr (Assault Rifles)
help: Equip your Panzer Infantry squad with MP44 Assault Rifles that provide excellent mid and short-range firepower.

name: MP44 Sturmgewehr (Assault Rifles)
help: Equip your Panzer Infantry squad with MP44 Assault Rifles that provide excellent mid and short-range firepower.

name: Panzer Grenadier Evolution
help: Enables Panzer Grenadier Bonuses until they can be automated.

name: Panzer Grenadier Evolution
help: Enables Panzer Grenadier Bonuses until they can be automated.
extra: Addition:  Sprint Ability, Elite Armor is issued.

name: Panzer Grenadier Evolution
help: Enables Panzer Grenadier Bonuses until they can be automated.
extra: Addition: G43 Anti Infantry Rifle Upgrade

name: Panzer Grenadier Evolution
help: Enables Panzer Grenadier Bonuses until they can be automated.
extra: Addition: Passive accuracy bonus and harder to suppress

help: Enables Panzer Grenadier Bonuses until they can be automated.

name: Panzer Grenadier Evolution
help: Enables Panzer Grenadier Bonuses until they can be automated.
extra: Addition: MOB Bonus! Panzer Grenadiers are tougher to kill when amassed

name: Panzer Grenadier Evolution
help: Enables Panzer Grenadier Bonuses until they can be automated.

name: Kampfgruppe Kompanie
help: Panzer Grenadier Bonus: Upgrades Grenadier repair to Advanced Repair
extra: Can Construct: Light AT Halftrack (250/10), Mortar Halftrack (250/7), Halftrack (250)

name: Kampfgruppe Kompanie Upgrade
help: Allows Grenadier Tank Buster squads to be built and unlocks the panzerschreck upgrade on Panzer Grenadier squads.

name: Logistik Kompanie
help: Panzer Grenadier Bonus: Unlocks the Anti Tank Grenade ability
extra: Can Construct: Logistik Car, Munitions Halftrack, Light Armored Car (SdKfz 222)

name: Logistik Kompanie Upgrade
help: Allows Grenadier Tank Buster squads to be built and unlocks the panzerschreck upgrade on Grenadier squads.

name: Advanced Repair
help: Upgrade the repair rate of your Panzer Grenadiers, Assault Grenadiers, and Tank Busters.

name: Anti Tank Grenades
help: Enables Anti Tank Grenades on your Panzer Grenadier, Assault Grenadier, and Tank Buster squads.

name: Field Craft
help: Increase the Capture Rate of your Panzer Grenadier, Assault Grenadier, and Tank Buster squads. When static, these squads are also trained to spot enemy mines.

name: Incendiary Grenades
help: Enables most Panzer Infantry with Incendiary Grenades that will burn an area for a period of time.
extra: Good vs. Garrisoned Infantry and Infantry

name: Group Zeal
help: Panzer Grenadiers, Assault Grenadiers, and Tank Busters are tougher when grouped together.

name: Defensive Operations
help: Upgrade your HQ Territory to recharge all Panzer Elite abilities and heal any injured infantry units. Will also heal units near Reinforcement Points.

name: Increase Squad Sizes
help: Increase Panzer Grenadier, Assault Grenadier, and Tank Buster squad sizes.

name: Veteran Sergeant
help: Upgrade your Panzer Grenadier, Assault Grenadier, and Tank Buster squads with a Veteran Sergeant who increases the rate squads receive veterancy and reduces the amount of suppression they receive.

name: Defensive Bonus 1
help: Gain a Defensive Veterancy Bonus.

name: Defensive Bonus 2
help: Gain a Defensive Veterancy Bonus.

name: Defensive Bonus 3
help: Gain a Defensive Veterancy Bonus.

name: Offensive Bonus 1
help: Gain an Offensive Veterancy Bonus.

name: Offensive Bonus 2
help: Gain an Offensive Veterancy Bonus.

name: Offensive Bonus 3
help: Gain an Offensive Veterancy Bonus.

name: Defensive Bonus
help: Give this squad a Defensive Veterancy Bonus, improving survivability and speed.

name: Defensive Bonus 2
help: Give this squad a Defensive Veterancy Bonus, improving survivability and speed.

name: Defensive Bonus 3
help: Give this squad a Defensive Veterancy Bonus, improving survivability and speed.

name: Offensive Bonus
help: Give this squad an Offensive Veterancy Bonus, improving weapon accuracy and rate of fire.

name: Offensive Bonus 2
help: Give this squad an Offensive Veterancy Bonus, improving weapon accuracy and rate of fire.

name: Offensive Bonus 3
help: Give this squad an Offensive Veterancy Bonus, improving weapon accuracy and rate of fire.

name: Zeal
help: Fanaticism causes Infantry Squads to fight more fiercely as they take losses.

name: Propaganda War
help: Superior Propaganda efforts demoralize Enemy Troops forcing a retreat to their HQ area.

name: King Tiger
help: A single, very powerful King Tiger is allocated to the battlefield, but only once. Such a decisive weapon should not be squandered.

name: Inspired Assault
help: Propaganda efforts inspire all Troops to attack the Enemy with renewed intensity with no regard for their personal safety while this ability is active.

name: Firestorm
help: Call Off-Map Bombardment to target an area. All Enemy Troops will be caught in a Firestorm.

name: V1 Rocket Attack
help: Call the terrifying V1 Rocket down on targeted area.

name: Upgrade to Barracks
help: Produce Troops from this Structure.

name: Fallschirmjager Infiltration
help: Fallschirmjager squads can be ordered to reveal themselves from pre-infiltrated hiding locations in buildings. Fallschirmjager squads camouflage automatically when in heavy cover.

name: Butterfly Bombs
help: Low flying aircraft can drop fields of SD-2 Butterfly bombs to disrupt the movement of enemy infantry and light vehicles.

name: Henschel Combat Air Patrol
help: Henschel Hs. 129 ground attack aircraft will provide tactical air-cover with their powerful 75mm cannons. Aircraft will monitor targeted locations for enemy vehicles or tanks.

name: Luftwaffe Ground Forces
help: Luftwaffe ground forces are adequate soldiers who can construct light defenses and, more importantly, devastating AA weapons including the Flakvierling  quad 20mm cannon.

name: Wirblewind Flakpanzer
help: Order a dangerous Wirblewind Flakpanzer that can provide mobile AA coverage, or engage enemy infantry and light vehicles.

name: Flak 36 88mm Cannon
help: Luftwaffe Ground Forces  are able to construct the fearsome 88mm Flak 36, a dual role weapon capable of targeting both air and ground units at long ranges.

name: Booby Trap Building
help: Panzer Elite infantry can be ordered to plant deadly booby traps inside any building on the map. Enemy infantry entering the building will suffer extreme consequences.

name: Booby Trap Strategic Point
help: Panzer Elite infantry can be ordered to booby trap any strategic point in the game. Booby traps are triggered by enemy units attempting to capture the point.

name: Sector Artillery
help: A selected sector is monitored for enemy activity. When enemy units are detected, the area is  saturated with artillery until that enemy activity ceases.

name: Roadblocks
help: Massive roadblocks are built that cannot be crushed by any unit, forcing the enemy to direct combat resources to destroying the barricades.

name: Scorched Earth
help: Following the ancient doctrine of scorched earth, Strategic Points can be disabled, denying their use to the enemy.

name: Hummel Self-Propelled Artillery
help: A Hummel Self-Propelled 150mm howitzer can devastate large swaths of ground at long range with its massive shells.

name: Teller Mines
help: Panzer Elite infantry can deploy Teller Mines. These weapons require great mass to trigger, meaning only vehicles will cause the mine to explode.

name: Hetzer Tank
help: A Hetzer Tank Hunter is available for reinforcement. These maneuverable tanks have thick sloping armor, and their small size means they are easily camouflaged.

name: Double Infantry AT Efforts
help: Panzerschreck upgrades now provide two Panzerschrecks, and AT grenade abilities now throw two AT Grenades.

name: Tank Awareness
help: Panzer Elite infantry use their improved battlefield skills to detect enemy tanks at ranges beyond which they can see.

name: APCR Rounds
help: AT guns and main tank guns are issued the more powerful APCR (Armor Piercing Composite Rigid) Panzergranate 40 ammunition that will improve armor penetration.

name: Jagdpanther Tank Destroyer
help: A  very rare and powerful Jagdpanther is allocated only once to each commander. Extremely well armed and armored, the Jagdpanther is capable of tackling all enemy units.

name: Forward Observation Officers
help: Allows Lieutenants and Captains to call in off-map artillery barrages, and the Command Tank can drop smoke to create cover.

name: Creeping Barrage
help: Howitzers and Priests can fire a series of shells in rapid succession creating a path of destruction.

name: Priest 105mm SPG
help: A 105mm Howitzer mounted on a lightly Armored Sherman chassis provides mobile fire support.

name: Supercharge Artillery Rounds
help: 25 Pounders, Priests, and mortar emplacements get supercharged shell propellant bags for vastly increased weapon range.

name: Overwatch Artillery
help: 25 Pounders, Priests, and Mortar Emplacements can be set to watch an area for incoming units and barrage them with artillery fire.

name: Counter Battery
help: Enables 25 Pounder and Mortar Emplacements to be toggled into Counter Battery, where they will fire back at enemy artillery automatically.

name: Glider-borne  Commandos
help: Call in a section of elite, Glider-borne Commandos.

name: Tetrarch Tank
help: A heavy Hamilcar glider can deliver a Tetrarch light tank armed with a 2 Pounder gun.

name: Glider Headquarters
help: Call in a glider Headquarters that can produce Commando Mortar sections, Command Vickers HMG Teams, and PIAT armed tank hunting teams.

name: Radio Triangulation Detectors
help: Infantry units can place Radio Triangulation Detectors to track the movement of enemy units.

name: Ultra Decryption
help: Secret intelligence generated through Ultra Decryption enables British players access to enemy orders.

name: Decoy Artillery
help: Grants decoy and artillery barrages. Use them in combination to keep your opponent guessing.

name: Improved Emplacements
help: Royal Engineers use their knowledge of fortifications to reinforce all weapon emplacements to make them more resistant to damage.

name: Hull Down
help: British Tanks are able to improve their defensive capabilities at the cost of mobility.

name: Improved Command Vehicles
help: Command HQs, Field Support Trucks, and Armored Command Trucks can move more quickly, increase population cap, take less damage, and generate more resources.

name: Churchill Infantry Tank
help: The lightly armed, but heavily Armored Churchill Tank will support Royal Engineer operations and can also be equipped with a mine plow.

name: Churchill AVRE
help: The Churchill AVRE can use its devastating Petard Mortar to smash through enemy obstacles.

name: Churchill Crocodile
help: The Churchill Crocodile wields a 6 Pounder gun and a fearsome flame projector.
